MODEL: QuoVLA
  Organization: Tsinghua University (Department of Automation)
  Date: 2026-05-24
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24890
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Flow-matching action expert (~300M, inherited from pi0.5) preceded by a quantized 1-layer Transformer prefix module. Dual-branch design: main branch uses 8-bit symmetric uniform quantization on prefix tokens (with adaptive straight-through estimator) while a stop-gradient raw-prefix reference branch supplies temporal complexity targets.
    Backbone: pi0.5 with PaliGemma-2.6B VLM
    LLM: PaliGemma-2.6B
    Parameters: 2.6B VLM (PaliGemma) + 300M action expert (~2.9B total)
  Tags: libero, libero-plus, robotwin, flow-matching, quantization, pi0.5, PaliGemma, prefix-compression, real-world

    libero (avg=99.6): libero_spatial=99.8, libero_object=99.9, libero_goal=100.0, libero_long=98.7, libero_avg=99.6
    robotwin_v2 (avg=51.85): easy_avg=45.1, hard_avg=58.6, robotwin_v2_avg=51.85
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned per suite', 'robotwin_v2': 'RoboTwin 2.0 easy + hard splits', 'real_world': '4 real-robot manipulation tasks, 100 demos each'}
  AI Review Summary: pi0.5 backbone에 **8-bit symmetric uniform quantization**을 prefix token (VLM 출력)에 적용한 1-layer Transformer 모듈을 삽입, **dual-branch (quantized + raw stop-gradient reference)** 구조와 **relative temporal-complexity regularization**으로 학습 — *"VLM 표현은 action-sufficient하지만 overcomplete하다"*는 Quotient Theory를 구현,

MODEL: SnapFlow
  Organization: Jilin University / Chongqing University / University of Liverpool / GenY
  Date: 2026-04-07
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05656
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Flow-matching action expert distilled to a single forward pass (1-NFE) via progressive FM/consistency mixing using a two-step Euler shortcut target and a zero-initialized target-time MLP embedding that lets the network switch between local velocity estimation (s = t) and global one-step generation (s = 0)
    Backbone: Applied to pi0.5 (3B, PaliGemma backbone, cross-attention action expert) and SmolVLA (~500M, SmolVLM backbone, concatenation-based action expert); VLM backbone frozen; only action expert (~300M for pi0.5) and target-time MLP trained
    LLM: PaliGemma (Gemma) for pi0.5; SmolVLM for SmolVLA
    Parameters: 3B (pi0.5) and 500M (SmolVLA)
  Tags: flow-matching, distillation, consistency-models, inference-acceleration, one-step, libero, pi0.5, smolvla
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=98.75): libero_spatial=99.0, libero_object=100.0, libero_goal=99.0, libero_long=97.0, libero_avg=98.75
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned (pi0.5 backbone + SnapFlow self-distillation, 1-NFE inference)'}
  AI Review Summary: pi0.5(3B)와 SmolVLA(500M) 같은 flow-matching VLA의 10-step Euler denoising을 "FM sample + two-step Euler shortcut consistency sample" progressive mixing과 zero-initialized target-time embedding으로 **1-NFE forward pass**에 압축하는 plug-and-play self-distillation. pi0.5 LIBERO 평균 98.75%(10-step teacher 97.75% 대비
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: IntentVLA
  Organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST), Zhongguancun Academy (Beijing), Zhongguancun Computing Institute, Harbin Institute of Technology, HKUST(GZ), BUAA, Zhejiang Normal University, East China Normal University, USTC, DeepCybo
  Date: 2026-05-14
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14712
  Code: https://github.com/ZGC-EmbodyAI/IntentVLA
  Venue: None
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: DiT-based flow-matching action chunk head conditioned on a short-horizon intent representation. Recent visual observations are encoded by a frozen VGGT-1B (camera + register tokens retained), then fused with the current Qwen3-VL 4B context via gated cross-attention to form the intent condition. Conditional flow-matching loss L_flow = E[||V_hat(X_s, s | C_t) - (tau_t - eps)||_2^2].
    Backbone: Qwen3-VL 4B (current context) + VGGT-1B (frozen, history encoder)
    LLM: None
    Parameters: ~5B total (Qwen3-VL 4B trainable + VGGT-1B frozen)

  AI Review: PDF-verified

  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Two-stage cross-task RL framework. Stage 1 (offline pre-training): Information Bottleneck objective max I(Z;A) - lambda_IB * I(Z;O), implemented via variational lower bound L_base = E[-log pi(a|z)] + lambda_IB * MINE-style term. MODEL: StableVLA
  Organization: Peking University, Tsinghua University, Astribot, Nanjing University, Nankai University

  Venue: ICML 2026
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Fused Information Bottleneck Adapter (Fused IB-Adapter) on top of a Prismatic-style VLA. MODEL: LoopVLA
  Organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST), Wuhan United Imaging Surgical Co., Ltd.
  Date: 2026-05-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09948
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Recurrent refinement: first 4 transformer layers (Perceptual Anchor Layers, PAL) are frozen, then a shared 3-layer Loop Block is applied iteratively (up to 8 iterations) on multimodal tokens. Each iteration produces (a) a candidate action via the action head and (b) a halting probability via the sufficiency head. Remaining Mass Allocation (RMA) converts halting scores into a valid distribution p(n) = s(n)*r(n) over refinement steps. Two-stage training: Stage 1 supervises all intermediates with L1 + entropy/diversity regularization; Stage 2 calibrates halting distribution to action-quality-derived target via KL divergence.
    Backbone: Qwen3VL-2B-Instruction (SigLIP-2 visual encoder + 28-layer transformer decoder)
    LLM: None
    Parameters: LoopOFT*: 1.2B (vs 2.2B Qwen3OFT baseline, -45%); LoopFM: 1.3B (vs 2.3B Qwen3FM, -43%)
  Tags: libero, libero-plus, vla-arena, recurrent, sufficiency, early-exit, efficiency, qwen3-vl
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=95.85): libero_spatial=95.0, libero_object=100.0, libero_goal=97.4, libero_long=91.0, libero_avg=95.85
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned', 'libero_plus': 'zero-shot generalization (camera/robot/language/light/background factors)', 'vla_arena': 'fine-tuned; L0 (safety/distractor/extrapolation/long-horizon)'}
  AI Review Summary: "VLA backbone의 가장 깊은 표현이 항상 최적"이라는 통념을 정면 반박. 4 frozen Perceptual Anchor Layer 위에 3-layer shared Loop Block을 최대 8회 반복 적용하면서, 매 iteration마다 후보 action + sufficiency score를 산출. Remaining Mass Allocation(RMA)과 self-supervised distribution alignment로 "언제 멈출지"를 학습. Qwen3VL-2B에서 파라미터 -45%(2.2B→1.2B) + 처리량 
  AI Review: PDF-verified

  Date: 2026-05-21

  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Action decoder with recurrent scene prefix. Maintains a persistent action-updated scene state across chunked control calls. At each VLM call: (a) observation slots extract fresh visual evidence per-view; (b) prior slots inherit the scene state from the previous chunk; (c) action decoder jointly denoises the next action chunk AND a compact scene update via flow-matching ('Joint Action-Scene Denoising'). Two training-only auxiliaries: Scene Predictor (supervises future scene-token targets) and Geometric Anchor (two-level: local depth + global 3D foundation model teacher). Both are discarded at deployment.
    Backbone: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (hidden dim D=2048)

MODEL: Tabero
  Organization: affiliations not disclosed in arXiv preprint (authors: Qiwei Wu, Rui Zhang, Xin Xiang, Tao Li, Weihua Zhang, Junjie Lai, Renjing Xu)
  Date: 2026-05-27
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27886
  Code: https://github.com/NathanWu7/Tabero
  Venue: ICML (submission as listed in paper)
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Flow-matching action expert (pi0-style) extended with a decoupled force-position command interface: the policy outputs desired end-effector pose plus a target applied force, executed by a fixed admittance-based hybrid low-level controller with a grip-force feedback loop (feedforward gain + admittance correction).
    Backbone: pi0 (PaliGemma 3B VLM + flow-matching action expert) with added tactile tokenizers
    LLM: PaliGemma (pi0 backbone)
    Parameters: pi0 base (~3B PaliGemma backbone; tactile tokenizers add minor overhead) -- exact total not reported
  Tags: pi0, flow-matching, tactile, force-feedback, gentle-manipulation, libero-subset, simulation-only, open-source, lora
  Benchmarks:
    libero: libero_object_partial=87.0, dataset_A_firm_SR=0.87, dataset_A_gentle_SR=0.79, dataset_A_firm_grip_force_N=31.3, dataset_A_gentle_grip_force_N=8.5, dataset_B_firm_SR=0.86, dataset_B_gentle_SR=0.52, dataset_B_firm_grip_force_N=32.4, dataset_B_gentle_grip_force_N=3.7
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'Tabero-Object 9-task subset in tactile simulator with force regimes A/B', 'real_world': 'not evaluated -- noted as future work'}
  AI Review Summary: pi0 backbone에 *decoupled 힘-위치(force-position) 하이브리드 command interface*와 *tactile token (TCN/MLP) 입력*을 결합하여 "gently/firmly" 같은 언어 부사에 따라 grip force를 동적으로 modulate하는 VLA — Tabero-VTLA. 시뮬레이션에서 LIBERO-Object trajectories를 force regime별로 replay해 데이터를 확보, 평균 grip force를 **70% 감소** (gentle 명령 시).
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: UniT
  Organization: XPeng Robotics / Tsinghua University / The University of Hong Kong
  Date: 2026-04-21
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19734
  Code: https://xpeng-robotics.github.io/unit/
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Hybrid two-stage. (1) UniT Token Prediction: learnable queries q_t appended to the VLM sequence; VLM predicts discrete UniT codes c_t = UniT(o_t, o_{t+k}, a_{t:t+k}, s_t) via parallel cross-entropy classification (not causal next-token AR). (2) Flow-Matching action head V_θ on action chunks A_t = [a_t,...,a_{t+H-1}], τ ∈ U[0,1], interpolated path A^τ_t = τA_t + (1−τ)ε; trained with L_fm = E[||V_θ(A^τ_t | x_t, Enc(o_t), τ) − (A_t − ε)||²]. Total: L_VLA = L_token + λ_fm·L_fm.
    Backbone: frozen DINOv2 (visual branch acts as inverse-dynamics model anchor)
    LLM: Qwen2.5-VL (used as VL backbone within the GR00T n1.5 framework)
    Parameters: TODO
  Tags: latent-action, cross-embodiment, humanoid, human-video, world-model, hybrid, flow-matching
  Benchmarks:
    robocasa (avg=66.0): robocasa_gr1_pick_place=67.3, robocasa_gr1_articulated=64.7
  Eval Conditions: {'robocasa': 'Full training data (24×1000 trajs); VLA-UniT (Qwen2.5-VL)'}
  AI Review Summary: Human egocentric video와 humanoid action을 "visual consequence"를 공통 anchor로 삼아 **embodiment-agnostic discrete latent space**로 통합하는, tri-branch cross-reconstruction 기반의 통합 physical language tokenizer.
  AI Review: PDF-verified

================================================================================
SECTION 3: BENCHMARK DEFINITIONS
================================================================================

LIBERO: 4 manipulation suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, Long-horizon)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.
  Primary ranking metric for VLA-Tracker.

CALVIN: Long-horizon language-conditioned manipulation (ABC→D setting)
  Score: Average number of tasks completed in sequence (0-5). Higher is better.

SimplerEnv: Sim-to-real transfer evaluation
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RoboTwin v1/v2: Bimanual dual-arm manipulation (50+ tasks)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RLBench: Diverse manipulation tasks (18 tasks)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RoboCasa: Home robot manipulation tasks
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.
